goals.description: Short athlete-facing outcome phrases, e.g. ["more power hitting sixes", "faster between-wicket running"]. Free text and deliberately NOT a controlled vocabulary: the real shape is not known until real examples exist. Optional - leaving this absent is correct where no genuine outcome is obvious from the complex itself; do not invent one to fill the gap.

muscles.description: primary muscles trained, reference only. Optional - leaving this absent is correct where no muscle focus is obvious from the complex itself.

how_to_perform.description: a fuller teaching walkthrough, distinct from the terse execution line and the short manual.cue. Optional - leaving this absent is correct where no additional teaching detail is provided.

guidance.description: a typical rep/hold range for reference only -- NOT a per-athlete prescription. AEON does not store prescriptions; actual numbers are set per session in the Workout builder. Optional - leaving this absent is correct where no rep/hold guidance is provided.
